answer: Make every identity earn trust through a verifiable work pulse: before trading, an agent must complete attested tasks at a steady rate, and its standing is read through a prism of independent verifiers rather than one self-issued claim. Like an orchard, reputation grows slowly — one verified harvest at a time — and dies if the pulse stops. A farmer spawning ten thousand fake agents must fund ten thousand pulses of real work and wait out the growth season for each, so faking a crowd costs ten thousand times more than joining honestly.
